findings.message: Consider enclosing schema constraints before rejecting branch normalization as ambiguous.
findings.rationale: Candidates are validated only against their individual branch. For example, extend the existing ambiguous-union fixture so entry also requires a. With raw {entry:{a:null,b:null}}, branch one produces {b:null}, while branch two produces {a:null}. Only the second satisfies the enclosing required:['a'] constraint, so the full host schema has one valid decoded result. This code still treats both candidates as ambiguous, leaves the raw object unchanged, and rejects it. This violates the requirement to decode applicable branches while preserving explicitly allowed nulls. Filter normalization candidates using the enclosing constraints before determining ambiguity, and add a regression distinguishing this case from genuinely ambiguous results.

findings.message: Preserve lazy collection enumeration through enclosing unions.
findings.rationale: Wrapping the final ambiguous-array fixture's items schema in anyOf:[{type:'array',items:item},{type:'null'}] sends the entire array product through unique(), which exhausts and stores every distinct result before yielding. Reviewer reproduction with eight items observed 257 array serializations, including all 256 combinations, before ambiguity was returned. With 1000 items this implies 2^1000 combinations, blocking synchronous response validation instead of promptly rejecting ambiguity. The new regression tests only a direct array schema and misses this wrapper. Merge equivalent provenance without eagerly exhausting descendant collection products, and add an enclosing-union regression.

testCoverage.explanation: Inspected all four supplied test files, including bodies and assertions, against every acceptance requirement. Coverage includes error:null decoding in structured, bounded-review, streamed-candidate and final paths; nested objects, recursive references, arrays, tuples, dictionaries, pattern precedence, explicit null preservation, required-null rejection, original bounds, typed diagnostics, immutability, enclosing constraints, deferred provenance, both allOf orders, equivalent alternatives, Claude compatibility and Vibe validation-only behavior. The demonstrated gap is collection ambiguity beneath an enclosing union, reported above. Builder-reported 48-case/build/typecheck results were not treated as reviewer executions.
